card.name: Linking words in locale variable descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and hyphens inside two repeated web passages: the POSIX locale environment variable description and a forum post header with a registration prompt and date.

modes.label: Locale variable text
modes.description: Small words like to, the, of, for inside the description of which locale to use for message format and byte interpretation.
modes.example: Determine the locale that should be used<< to>> affect the format and contents of diagnostic messages

modes.label: Forum header dashes
modes.description: Hyphens in a forum page after the register prompt and inside the date.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are Java Swing terms, so it mainly steers away from Java GUI code continuations.
card.plain: It fires on filler words and dashes in two specific repeated web passages, a locale settings description and a forum post header.
